name: Process: Design the departure read in three passes, and what the brief carries
text_content:
P30, answering carryover 86akh7r0c's departure half. The week of a departure: the inventory's tension-loss row (field 15, what the node held), the leads' review's line naming what the node held and which seats carry it, the pool read recorded before the seat opens externally, and the adjacent seats' thermal-load and check-in lines over the following weeks. Then the memory-failure read the record's five modes do not carry by name (finding 19.1): whether what the node held was in the system, with each "in its head" written as sequence corruption or skill invisibility, so the departure's cost is bounded in the only unit this program carries, which mechanism now has to be maintained. Then, at re-fill, whether the re-established node carries the tension, as a read-back. The floor hears the structural fact as coverage at the brief under its standing change line and nothing about the person; this reconciles S3 P11.6 (told at the brief with its tension map) with S7 P47 (nothing about a person is said to the floor) and S8 P49 (no announcement) by narrowing the tension map to coverage, and the practice is Session 11's. Blocks I8 and row 113. High.

Filed by Session 9 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmj07. Reasoning lives on the S9 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

comment.text:
Extended by Session 15. The three passes stand unchanged for every kind of departure; Session 15 adds the departing lead's hand-back block against the records and the exit interview's building lines as sources for the memory-failure pass, and adds one line to the change-reach record for a departure of the second or third kind: the person's conversation dated before the brief's coverage and before the state's save (S15 sections 5.1 and 5.3). The brief carries coverage and nothing about the person; a word about a departed person in any room is a range breach with a named destination (S15 P32).
